title: Hausdorff measure of a bi-Lipschitz image of a subset of ℝⁿ
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, χ : ℝ^n → ℝ^P, E ⊆ ℝ^n and real numbers c₁ > 0, c₂ ≥ 0 such that c₁|a − b| ≤ |χ(a) − χ(b)| ≤ c₂|a − b| for all a, b ∈ E. Then c₁ⁿ·Lⁿ(E) ≤ Hⁿ(χ(E)) ≤ c₂ⁿ·Lⁿ(E), where Lⁿ is Lebesgue measure (volume) on ℝ^n = Euclid n and Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^P (all quantities in [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (χ : Euclid n → Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid n)) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ), 0 < c₁ → 0 ≤ c₂ → (∀ a ∈ E, ∀ b ∈ E, c₁ * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖χ a - χ b‖ ∧ ‖χ a - χ b‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖a - b‖) → ENNReal.ofReal (c₁ ^ n) * volume E ≤ μHE[n] (χ '' E) ∧ μHE[n] (χ '' E) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c₂ ^ n) * volume E
